The role of the Manager of Ontology and Data Modeling is to develop, implement, and maintain enterprise ontologies in support of Capital One's Data Strategy.

With this replacement, we are looking for someone to champion the creation and adoption of standardized data. The Manager of Ontology and Data Modeling will be responsible for partnering with Technology, Product, and other Capital One teams to support the development and integration of semantic technology into Capital One products and services.

The Manager of Ontology and Data Modeling should be capable of supporting an emerging and evolving semantic program at Capital One, capable of clearly communicating and advocating the value of using semantic technology and knowledge organization concepts.

Leverage customer insights to influence priorities and roadmap development while advocating for and driving alignment between stakeholders in the development of acceptance criteria

At The Coca‑Cola Company, our ambition is to refresh the world and make a difference, and finance plays a critical role in bringing that vision to life. In this role, you will contribute to accurate product costing and pricing processes, delivering insights that support innovation and operational excellence across multiple regions. By leveraging your analytical expertise and digital fluency, you will help optimize supply chain transparency, standardize processes, and build efficiencies that support growth across emerging and established markets. If you are passionate about finance, technology, and improving global processes in a collaborative and forward‑thinking organization, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact within one of the world’s most recognized brands.

• Prepare, release, and maintain product standard costs and related SAP master data for new product launches or reformulations for assigned plant locations, ensuring accurate and timely communication to stakeholders.

• Execute re‑costing of materials based on Bill of Material changes, analyzing cost impacts and validating results for assigned plants.

• Lead Pricing and Purchase Price Variance (PPV) processes for assigned locations, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure pricing compliance and accuracy

• Oversee daily deliverables from third‑party service providers for pricing and accounting tasks, validating work against internal controls and corrective action standards.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for costing and pricing escalations, applying a broad perspective to resolve complex issues.

• Promote consistent application of global standards and best practices in cost and pricing management, partnering with regional teams for continuous improvements.

• Reconcile and monitor Cost of Goods Sold clearing account balances for timely recognition of financial results.

• Drive process optimization by identifying opportunities for enhancement, preparing perfrmance metrics, and facilitating alignment across teams.

• Act as finance subject‑matter contributor on global initiatives such as S/4HANA deployments and other supply chain transformations, ensuring finance requirements are effectively represented.

• Professional accounting designation (CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.

• Proven proficiency in SAP or similar integrated manufacturing systems.

• Fluency in English; additional languages such as Spanish and Portuguese are a plus.

• Ability to build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and manage external service provider performance.
